description: A network troubleshooting scenario: You are investigating connectivity issues for a monitoring tool that uses the configuration file /home/user/network/monitor_config.ini. 1. Inspect the contents of /home/user/network/monitor_config.ini. It uses the standard INI format, with sections such as [network] and [alert]. 2. Extract the value of the gateway key from the [network] section of the INI file. 3. Print ONLY the value of gateway to the terminal standard output. Do not include any extra text, whitespace, or unit labels. The output must match the value set in the INI file exactly. The automated test will check that your console output is exactly the gateway value as it appears in the file.
